Summary

Every branch of universitybikeshop.com as a tree, down to each download. The site has 106 pages: 12 public pages in the navigation bar, 75 unlisted pages that search engines may index, and 19 unlisted pages kept out of search engines. Below them sit 178 downloadable files (272 MB in all). Grey folder names are URL segments with no page of their own; where one has a section on its parent page, the name links there. Click a file count to list the files.

  • public In the navigation bar and the sitemap.
  • unlisted Not linked from the public site, but search engines may index it.
  • noindex Not linked from the public site, and kept out of search engines.
